newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ RETAIL MANAGED FUNDS TOTAL NZ$13.01 BLN - ISI.
newsitem.headline: NZ RETAIL MANAGED FUNDS TOTAL NZ$13.01 BLN - ISI.

text.p: Retail managed funds in New Zealand totalled NZ$13.01 billion at June 30, up $1.8 billion on the previous year, the Investment Savings and Insurance Association (ISI) said on Thursday.
The ISI said in its Annual Review a further $1.28 billion was attributed to New Zealand-based investment in Australian unit trusts.

The net inflow of $638.8 million for the year to June 30 was slightly down on the $837 million recorded for the previous June year, but more than twice the $320 million net inflow in the year to March 31, 1997.
"The net inflow of $434.4 million for the June 1997 quarter was the highest quarterly net inflow since the June 1994 quarter," the association said.

Unit trusts, group investment funds (GIFs) and superannuation funds all recorded net inflows, with GIFs growing significantly through the introduction to the market during the year of index-tracking "passive" funds.
Insurance bonds continued their trend of net outflows. Their share of total retail managed funds fell to 19 percent in the year to June 30, from 21.7 percent.
In-force superannuation rose 13.7 percent in the year to June, while regular annual contributions to superannuation schemes rose 18 percent. Single premium contributions rose 87 percent.
